---
title: "Europe"
subtitle: "Top 100 researchers based in Europe"
date: today
date-format: "MMMM YYYY"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
top100 <- read.csv("../../out/gb_top100_v02.csv",
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                   fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
EU_COUNTRIES <- c("GB","FR","DE","IT","ES","NL","CH","AT","BE","DK","FI","GR",
                  "HU","IE","IS","LU","MT","NO","PL","PT","RO","SE","SI","SK",
                  "BG","CZ","EE","LT","LV","HR","RS","MK","BA","AL","ME","BY",
                  "RU","UA","MD","GE","AM","AZ","TJ","TR","CY","IL","PS","JO",
                  "LB","SY")
eu_pts <- top100 %>%
  filter(country %in% EU_COUNTRIES) %>%
  arrange(merged_rank)
```

`r nrow(eu_pts)` Top 100 researchers are based in Europe.

:::

## Listing

```{r eu-table}
display <- eu_pts %>%
  transmute(
    Rank        = merged_rank,
    Name        = name,
    Institution = institution,
    Country     = country
  )
DT::datatable(
  display,
  rownames = FALSE,
  options = list(pageLength = 25, dom = 'fltip',
                 order = list(list(0, 'asc'))),
  class = 'compact stripe hover'
)
```
